title: incident-bot: oncall runbook autodiagnostics suggestions and SLO-toolkit integration
author: Sophie Lin
description: Context: on-call engineers often need quick, actionable runbook suggestions during incidents. The incident-bot previously surfaced static runbook links and SLO pointers but did not suggest runbooks based on recent automated diagnostics or correlate SLO-toolkit findings to runbook steps. Motivation: reduce time-to-first-action on oncall pages by surfacing candidate runbooks, relevant diagnostic snippets, and suggested next steps derived from SLO-toolkit automated diagnostics. Summary: implement a lightweight suggestion layer that 1) matches automated diagnostics signatures to runbook metadata, 2) surfaces ranked suggestions in the incident-bot oncall flow, and 3) annotates suggestions with diagnostic excerpts and confidence scores. This change integrates SLO-toolkit tags, extends runbook metadata, and adds a suggestion service with safeguards (rate limiting, opt-out). Key changes: - incident-bot: add suggestion controller and UI payloads to expose runbook suggestions and diagnostic snippets in the oncall DM/Slack flow - slo-toolkit: export stable diagnostic tags and short diagnostic summaries consumed by the suggestion controller - runbooks: extend runbook metadata with keywords, affected-services, and canonical-diagnostics fields (backwards compatible; older runbooks still surface) - tests: unit and e2e mocks for matching heuristics; integration test against a local SLO-toolkit test fixture - docs: update oncall playbook docs describing opt-out and tuning knobs Rollout plan: feature gated behind incident-bot config (suggestions.enabled=false by default). Phased rollout: alpha on internal teams (2 days), beta with opt-in for external customers (2 weeks), full release after telem confirms precision>=0.7 on sampled incidents. Backwards compatibility: runbook metadata extension is additive; no runtime change required if suggestion feature disabled. Testing: ran full CI (lint/unit/integration), manual end-to-end on staging Slack workspace, and a canary release to internal oncall rotas. Observability: added metrics suggestion.match_rate, suggestion.latency_ms, suggestion.confidence_distribution and traces for matching pipeline. Security/privacy: only surfaced diagnostic snippets that are annotated as non-sensitive by slo-toolkit; opt-out exists per-team. Checklist: [x] unit tests [x] e2e staging tests [x] integration tests with SLO-toolkit fixture [x] docs updated [x] migration covered Related Linear: ENG-4123, ENG-4190
